messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: What does it mean "..scaled.."
parts:
It means that the density is divided by its maximum so that when
rendered, the maximum value of the plotted density is one. It's also
referred to as a relative density. This idea is also applied to
likelihoods - relative likelihood is a likelihood function scaled so
that the maximum value of the likelihood is 1. So think of ..scaled..
as being something like
..scaled.. = ..density../max(..density..)

Dennis
